original_reference_restoration.trained_semantics: Stored int4 weights come from trained64-128-10ReLU ANN then quantization and calibrated integer rate-coded SNN conversion. Restored final_selected shift1/3/IF dynamics, subtractive reset,32steps,rng123 over the complete360-imagebatch. No direct SNN training or retraining is claimed.
original_reference_restoration.shift1_static_bound: For each neuron current in[L,H] from all binary-spike subsets, state stays in[2L,2H] under ceil(state/2)+current and positive-threshold subtractive reset; therefore postleakU lies[L,H], which is certified signed8. A statically narrow8-lane implementation is a valid stronger comparator for shift1.

original_IF_profile.semantics: Saved quantized/calibrated64-128-10ANN-to-integerSNNconversion; originalIF, subtractive reset,32steps, full360-imagebatch rng123. No retraining or direct SNN training.
original_IF_profile.domain: Exact signed13 membrane plus signed8 current to signed14 sum. U11 violations retained; no clipping or operand changes.
original_IF_profile.certificate: For each neuron, all binary input sums lie in[L,H], withL<=0<=H. Positive subtractive reset maps fired sums to nonnegative state; induction gives state aftertsteps in[tL,tH]. Thus before each of32steps U liesin[31L,31H]. Hardware output14bits covers the final32ndsum.

full_lane_policy_sweep.exact_layout: Same eight six-bit radix32 residue fields. Firstk positions handle fullU13; following positions require actualU8 and are consumed only as a contiguous prefix. Unadmitted operands return in full positions on next request. No sorting/reordering/coefficient/output changes.
full_lane_policy_sweep.worst_case: All narrow tail positions wide: pergroupceil(N/k)requests; with one-edge groupdrain,add1clockpergroup. Alltailnarrow:ceil(N/8). Bound is attained by legal U13 wide values in every position, independent of currents. Hardware backpressure and operand delivery can add unbounded waiting outside this service bound.
